reviews.title: Fast RAM that looks great in the build
reviews.comment:
This RAM has been amazing so far. Super fast, easy to install, and the 32 GB capacity gives my PC plenty of headroom for gaming and multitasking. My system picked it up right away with no issues and everything runs noticeably smoother.
On top of that, the Ripjaws design looks really cool inside the case. Great performance, solid brand I trust, and the price was definitely right.
reviews.author: Jessie Canon

reviews.title: Perfect for my motherboard!
reviews.comment: My previous RAM sticks (16GB) only equated to 15.3 or something like that, but here, you're actually getting the full 32GB and no obscure number. Easy to install, works perfectly. I've heard these last a long time, so you're pretty much good to go with memory. No colors or brightness, though. Pretty standard. Way better than the ones that came with my pre-built.
reviews.author: Josh Flores

reviews.title: Works great.
reviews.comment: DDR5 was ungodly expensive. So I'll save that upgrade for later. DDR4 still works for the time being.
reviews.author: Christian

reviews.title: G.SKILL RipjawsV Series DDR4 RAM (XMP) 128GB (4x32GB) 3200MT/s
reviews.comment:
Running these in 4 of the 8 slots on Asus Prime TRX40 Pro, with a 3970X Threadripper. I needed to be able to upgrade to 256 gigs if needed. Online manual says put them in the black slots closes to the CPU. :( NOPE it would not boot, reset bios, pulled cmos battery, all no go. Took them out and put them in the GREY SLOTS in booted right up first try. Went into the bios to set the 3200, but the bios already set them to 3600 at 1.22 volts (they are 1.35 volt sticks). So I just left it there stress tested the memory for 128 minutes not a single glitch. :) Nice black heat sinks NO RGB thank goodness!
The heat sinks not sure how well they work removing heat? But they look nice and make it super easy to set the memory pushing down right in the middle.
Great quality memory for an unbeatable price! Memory prices have gotten crazy again.
